about_the_game:
Resilient is a post-apocalyptic colony building and management game set in the dark 17th century. You must keep your people alive amid resource scarcity, ideological struggles, social tension, and the constant threat of the undead.

Organic City Building

Design your colony freely. Roads, fields, and layouts are entirely up to you. Every settlement grows into a unique character shaped by your choices.

Unique Colonists

Each colonist has distinct traits, relationships, and ideological leanings. Their values affect their reactions to events; fair laws may boost productivity, while oppression can spark rebellion.

Day-Night Cycle

Days are for production, research, and expansion; nights bring the fight for survival against evolving zombie hordes. Over time, the undead may become fast runners or thick-skinned threats.

Ideology and Law System

Choose from multiple ideologies to shape your colony’s future. Each one unlocks unique laws, production methods, and social effects. Colonists respond to your rule. Some see you as a leader, others as a tyrant.

Diplomacy and Exploration

Send scouting parties to reconnect with the outside world. Explore ruined towns, gather resources, and establish diplomatic ties. Relations with other colonies influence trade, cooperation, and ideology.

Social Tension and Rebellion

Hard choices can shake your colony’s stability. When morale collapses, production halts, famine spreads, and rebellion ignites.

Resilient delivers a colony simulation of deep production chains, social conflicts, belief systems, and a survival loop where every decision comes at a cost.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains mild violence set within a dark, survival-focused colony management world.

name: Resilient

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6700
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Targeting 50-60 FPS on “Medium” settings at 1080p resolution. SSD recommended due to active Lumen, Nanite, and Virtual Shadow Maps. Supports DLSS 4 and FSR 4 frame generation.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 9 7900x / Intel Core i9-13900K
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 4080 / RTX 5080 / AMD RX 7900 XTX
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Delivers 150-170 FPS on “Epic” settings at 1080p resolution. Lumen, Nanite, Virtual Texturing, and Virtual Shadow Maps fully enabled. Supports frame generation with DLSS 4 / FSR 4.

short_description: Begin with a handful of survivors after a 17th-century zombie apocalypse and build a growing colony. Shape its organic layout, establish production chains, define ideologies, and pass laws. Thrive by day, defend by night, and test your colony’s resilience against the undead.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Turkish, Polish
